_comment: ClubGG display name (as on Paul's sheet) -> person name in Paul's Book, so Approve posts into the existing ledger instead of creating a duplicate. A value 'staking:<horse>' means the member is a horse Paul stakes: the weekly run adds a RomanianClub week line to that horse (Staking tab) instead of an inbox debt. A value 'skip' means the member is Paul's own account: never proposed.
